notes: Pass-15 candidates that could not be listed: two unverifiable names, one closure confirmed by two independent sources, and one address conflict. Every rejection carries the page that produced the name.

rejected.name: Bobbi's Coffee Shop & Cafe
rejected.reason: Permanently closed on 2025-12-31 after 50+ years. SFGATE broke the closure on 2025-12-27 with a manager confirming it; Yelp now labels the page CLOSED ('Yelpers report this location has closed'); r/Cupertino carries the same story. No 2026 hours or lunch service exist, so no row is listed.

rejected.name: Konbini Club
rejected.reason: Only source is a Yelp ranking capture (5.0, 6 reviews, 'Closed until Sunday'); no street address, phone or weekly hours could be found in a follow-up search, so nothing could be verified line by line.

rejected.name: Hearth BBQ
rejected.reason: Name appears only in a Yelp ranking capture. A follow-up search for 'Hearth BBQ Cupertino hours lunch special' returns Hearth and Harrow (Connecticut) and Hearth (Peoria, Illinois) - no Cupertino business page, address or hours.

rejected.name: Layang Layang Malaysian Cuisine
rejected.reason: The Cupertino-area store is gone (TripAdvisor review: 'Unfortunately they only have their Milpitas store now'). The remaining pages disagree on the surviving address: 181 W Calaveras Blvd, Milpitas (wheree, yellowpages) versus 11 Butler St, Milpitas (TripAdvisor JSON-LD) versus 1480 S De Anza Blvd, San Jose (yellowpages, second listing). No single address could be verified, so the candidate is deferred rather than listed.

rejected.name: Di Paolo's
rejected.reason: A '3 Course for $20 Lunch Special 11am-3:30pm' page surfaced in a Palo Alto-area search, but dipaolosrestaurant.com belongs to Di Paolo's Ristorante Italiano, 28 S Broad St, Penns Grove, NJ (OpenTable listing), ~2,500 miles outside the 10-15 mile Cupertino ring. Rejected as out of ring rather than omitted silently.

rejected.name: Mountain View Chalet
rejected.reason: mountainviewchalet.com publishes 'LUNCH SPECIALS: 11:30 am - 4:00 pm Tuesday - Saturday', but the business is Mountain View Chalet, 154 State Route 173, Asbury, NJ - the name is a New Jersey restaurant, not the California city. Rejected as out of ring.
